meta.title: Open Speech Studio — Local speech-to-text | OpenAEC Foundation
meta.description: Speech recognition that runs on your own computer: dictate into any application with a hotkey, record meetings and turn audio and video into text. Free, for Windows, macOS and Linux.

header.label: Speech to text on your own computer
header.title: Open Speech Studio
header.desc: A desktop application for speech recognition that runs on your own computer. Hold Ctrl+Win and dictate into any application, record a meeting or have audio and video files transcribed. Built on Whisper, recognises 99 languages and runs on Windows, macOS and Linux.

slides.tts: Text to speech: a Dutch voice selected, sliders for speed, expressiveness and the pause between sentences, and below it the voice library with Dutch and English voices
slides.models: Speech models: the Whisper models from tiny to large-v3-turbo, each with its size, speed, accuracy and memory use; large-v3-turbo is active
slides.settings: Speech settings: recognition language, GPU acceleration with the graphics card that was found, auto paste, sound effects and the number of files processed at once

notice.text: Works offline too: the small model is included in the installer, so you can dictate right after installing, without internet and without an account.

features.label: Features
features.heading: From voice to text, without the cloud
features.sub: Start with the highlights or pick a topic.

dictate.alt: The Speech start screen: ready to speak, with the hotkey that starts dictation
dictate.title: Dictate into any application
dictate.desc: Hold Ctrl+Win, speak and let go: the text is typed wherever your cursor is. In an email, a chat, a word processor, a browser or a terminal. Rather not hold the keys? Set the hotkey to press once to start and again to stop.

meeting.alt: Record and transcribe: choice of language and how often the recording is transcribed along the way, the record button and a microphone level meter
meeting.title: Record and transcribe meetings
meeting.desc: While you record, the meeting is transcribed in pieces, so the transcript grows as you go. For an online meeting the application also records your PC audio on Windows, so the participants in Teams, Zoom or Meet end up in it too. With voice profiles you see who said what; save the transcript as .txt, .md or .odt.

files.alt: Transcribe files: an area to drop audio and video files on, with the supported formats
files.title: Turn audio and video into text
files.desc: Drop a recording, a voice memo or a video on the window: WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, M4A, MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV and more. Several files are processed side by side. Copy the result, or save it as a text file.

models.title: Fast or accurate, you choose
models.desc: Eight Whisper models, from tiny (75 MB) to large-v3 (3.1 GB). The small model is included in the installer, so you can start right away. Small models run smoothly on the processor; with a graphics card (CUDA or Vulkan) the large models are fast too. The language is detected automatically, or you fix it.

tts.title: Have text read aloud
tts.desc: It works the other way round too: paste a text and have it read aloud by a Dutch or English voice. The voices run on the processor of your own computer; each voice is a one-time download of 60 to 110 MB. You set the speed, expressiveness and the pause between sentences yourself. Windows only for now.

hotkey.title: Your own hotkey
hotkey.desc: A combination of two or three keys, to hold down or to switch on and off.

paste.title: Auto paste
paste.desc: The text appears where your cursor is; if you like, the application presses Enter after it as well.

overlay.title: Status window
overlay.desc: A small window shows that it is listening, with the sound level and the progress of the transcription.

sounds.title: Sound effects
sounds.desc: A sound on start, stop and done, from a few sound packs and at your own volume.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.desc: Teach the model names, abbreviations and jargon, and have words replaced automatically.

correct.title: Auto-correction
correct.desc: Let a language model on your own computer improve the transcribed text. Off by default.

meeting.title: Meetings
meeting.desc: In person with just the microphone, online with your PC audio as well (Windows).

segments.title: Transcribing while recording
segments.desc: The recording is transcribed every few minutes, or whenever you save a segment.

speakers.title: Speaker recognition
speakers.desc: Record a thirty-second voice profile for each person, and the speakers get a label in the transcript.

indicator.title: Recording indicator
indicator.desc: A small floating badge stays on top of other windows while recording.

files.title: Transcribe files
files.desc: Audio and video, several at once; double-click for a preview of the result.

export.title: Export
export.desc: Transcripts as .txt, .md or .odt, or saved automatically as text files in a folder of your choice.

models.title: Eight Whisper models
models.desc: From tiny to large-v3, with two compact versions of large-v3-turbo in between.

gpu.title: Graphics card or processor
gpu.desc: A graphics card (CUDA or Vulkan) makes it faster; it works without one too.

langs.title: 99 languages
langs.desc: Detected automatically or set by you, from Dutch and English to Turkish and Japanese.

ui.title: Interface in 25 languages
ui.desc: Including Dutch, English, French, Spanish and Turkish, switchable in Settings.

mictest.title: Microphone test
mictest.desc: Speak a sentence and check that your microphone and the recognition work properly.

tts.title: Text to speech
tts.desc: Nine Dutch and English voices that run on the processor (Windows).

keys.title: Hotkeys
keys.note: Ctrl+Win works on Windows and on Linux under X11. On macOS and under Wayland you use Ctrl+Shift+Space. In Settings you pick a combination of your own.

download.label: Download
download.title: Download v0.12.3
download.lead: Free and without an account. Every button starts the download right away.
download.metaWindows: Installer for Windows, 64-bit, with the small model included
download.metaMac: Disk image for Macs with an Apple processor
download.metaLinux: AppImage for Linux x86-64, runs on most distributions
download.mobileNote: Open Speech Studio is a desktop application for Windows, macOS and Linux. Download it on your computer; all files are listed below.

note.windows: Windows: the installer installs for all users of the computer and therefore asks for administrator rights. The small model is included, so you can dictate right after installing.
note.mac: macOS: the app is not yet signed with an Apple Developer ID. Open it the first time with right-click and Open, or allow it under System Settings, Privacy & Security. Grant access to the microphone and to Accessibility when asked. Text to speech and recording PC audio are not yet available on macOS.
note.linux: Linux: make the AppImage executable once with chmod +x and then start it. Ctrl+Win works under X11; under Wayland you use Ctrl+Shift+Space.

whatsnew.label: New in v0.12.3
whatsnew.title: A new logo, and back on macOS and Linux
whatsnew.desc: Released on 6 November 2026. This version brings the approved app logo. The two versions before it, from October, made the app usable again on macOS and Linux and added two mid-size models.

logo.title: Approved logo
logo.desc: The app, the installers and the icons use the logo that is also in the Snap Store.

mac.title: Back on macOS
mac.desc: Disk images for Macs with an Apple or an Intel processor, with Ctrl+Shift+Space as the hotkey.

linux.title: Self-contained Linux packages
linux.desc: AppImage, .deb, .rpm and Snap carry the speech engine and a model. Ctrl+Win now starts dictation under X11 too.

models.title: Two mid-size models
models.desc: Compact versions of large-v3-turbo (574 and 874 MB): clearly more accurate than small, at a similar download size.

cost.a: Nothing. Open Speech Studio is open source under the Apache-2.0 licence. No licence fees, no subscription and no account needed.

privacy.q: Does my voice go to the internet?
privacy.a: No. Recognition runs on your own computer; only models and voices are downloaded once. There is an option to have a remote server do the transcription, but it is off by default and only works after signing in.

systems.q: Which systems does it run on?
systems.a: Windows (64-bit), macOS on Apple and Intel processors, and Linux on x86-64 as AppImage, .deb, .rpm or Snap. Text to speech and recording PC audio only work on Windows for now. The Mac app is not yet signed with an Apple Developer ID: open it the first time with right-click and Open.

hotkey.q: Which hotkey do I use to dictate?
hotkey.a: On Windows you hold Ctrl+Win while you speak; Ctrl+Shift+Space works too. On macOS and under Wayland on Linux it is Ctrl+Shift+Space. In Settings you pick your own combination of two or three keys, and whether you hold the keys or press once to start and stop.

langs.a: Whisper recognises 99 languages, including Dutch, English, German, French, Spanish and Turkish. Let it detect the language automatically or fix it. The interface itself is available in 25 languages.

gpu.q: Do I need a graphics card?
gpu.a: No. The smaller models run well on the processor, and the small model is already included in the installer. With a graphics card (CUDA or Vulkan) the large models become fast enough for daily use.

online.q: Can I record an online meeting?
online.a: Yes, on Windows. Choose an online meeting when you start recording: the application then records your microphone and your PC audio together, so the other participants in Teams, Zoom or Meet end up in the transcript too.

files.q: Which files can I have transcribed?
files.a: Audio and video, such as WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, M4A, MP4, MKV, AVI and MOV. Drop several at once; they are processed side by side and you save the result as a text file.

tech.heading: Technology and licence
tech.sub: For those who want to know how it is built.

whisper.title: whisper.cpp
whisper.desc: The Whisper models run through whisper.cpp, on the processor or on a graphics card with CUDA or Vulkan.

tauri.title: Tauri 2 and Rust
tauri.desc: A desktop application with a Rust core for recording, recognition and files, for Windows, macOS and Linux.

ui.title: SolidJS
ui.desc: The interface is built with SolidJS and Vite, in the style of the OpenAEC desktop apps.

audio.title: Audio
audio.desc: Recording through cpal; on Windows the PC audio is mixed with the microphone for online meetings.

tts.title: Piper
tts.desc: Text to speech with Piper: small voice models that run on the processor without a graphics card or server.

license.title: Apache-2.0
license.desc: Free to use, modify and distribute. The source code is on GitHub, with the issues for a problem or a request.

final.desc: Install, press the hotkey, talk. Free, without an account and on your own computer.
